payload.title: Reuse unchanged living Report artifacts across milestones
payload.description:
As an optimization operator, I want living Report milestones to reuse unchanged score and scorecard artifacts, so that a portfolio run remains timely without losing immutable evidence or stakeholder-visible revisions.

Feature: Incremental living Report publication

Scenario: Most score findings are unchanged
  Given a prior committed Report revision contains checksum-verified score and scorecard artifacts
  And a later milestone changes only a subset of score findings
  When the later revision is published
  Then changed artifacts are regenerated and uploaded under immutable keys
  And unchanged artifacts are referenced from their previously verified immutable revisions
  And the revision manifest records whether each artifact was created or reused
  And workbook and portfolio counts still reconcile exactly

Scenario: Reuse evidence is unsafe
  Given a prior artifact is missing, unverified, or has a different content checksum
  When a later revision is published
  Then the artifact is regenerated and verified before the Report pointer advances

Scenario: Publication resumes after interruption
  Given a milestone publication is interrupted
  When the exact run resumes
  Then both newly uploaded and safely reused artifacts are recovered deterministically
  And no duplicate stakeholder artifact is required merely because the process restarted

Out of scope: retention changes, schema resources, hidden sheets, raw client content in Kanbus, and weakening immutable revision history.
